message: Guardrail (Chapter 1 - Prevent): read the policy name in this error.
F1 Locations: deploy only in Indonesia Central or Southeast Asia.
F2 Public exposure: a network interface must not have a public IP.
F2 Public exposure: do not open SSH (22) or RDP (3389) to the Internet.
F3 Data in transit: storage accounts must require HTTPS.
F3 Data in transit: storage accounts must use the approved TLS version.
F3 Data in transit: web apps must allow HTTPS only.
F4 Stored data and keys: a Key Vault needs purge protection.
F8 Segmentation: 0.0.0.0/0 must go through the hub firewall.
F9 Ownership: every resource needs the CostCenter tag.
F9 Ownership: every resource needs the Owner tag.
